final:
-- Zero-padded two-digit text for 0 <= n <= 99.
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0 and n <= 99
  post out.char_count() == 2
  ex pad2(7) == "07"
  if n < 10
    return "0\(n)"
  "\(n)"

-- UTC clock time of a Unix timestamp in seconds, as HH:MM:SS (24 hours).
stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  let s = ts % 86400
  let h = s // 3600
  let m = (s % 3600) // 60
  let sec = s % 60
  "\(pad2(h)):\(pad2(m)):\(pad2(sec))"
